wholePhysicalScope: Observatory-surveyed support axis, mapped operating area, and the original USGS one-metre grade. The Observatory and NRAO provide the reflector dimensions, axle elevation, and track diameter.
lodDetails: Four detail levels preserve the asymmetrical dish, trussed support, outboard feed and wheel track.
limitations: The telescope is a static high-elevation pose. The absolute azimuth and instantaneous observation target are representative.
The aperture span, base and axle are survey and specification based. Individual reflector panels, cabling, service equipment and connection details are represented at a coarser scale.
